text: Monzo Bank Limited is a UK-incorporated, VC-backed digital bank (company no. 09446231). Per Monzo's own October 2024 statement reported by Bloomberg, its shareholders include Singapore's sovereign wealth fund GIC Pte and StepStone Group, alongside other existing investors.

source.name: Bloomberg Law: 'Monzo Nabs $5.9 Billion Valuation After Employee Share Sale'
source.quote: Existing investors including StepStone Group Inc. and Singapore's sovereign wealth fund GIC Pte participated in the round, according to a statement.
